items.headline: European gas eases but storage lags
items.summary: European TTF gas prices slipped to around €52/MWh this week, the lowest in three weeks, as markets weighed a possible Strait of Hormuz de-escalation — though EU storage sits near 58% full, the lowest seasonal level in nearly two decades.

items.headline: Refined product margins hit record highs
items.summary: Diesel and gasoline crack spreads pushed to record levels even as crude oil pulled back, with refinery outages across the Gulf region and Russia's diesel export ban keeping fuel supply tighter than crude supply alone would suggest.

items.headline: US biofuel blending mandates jump for 2026
items.summary: New US blend requirements push biomass-based diesel mandates over 60% above last year's targets, the largest single-year increase in the program's history, as elevated fuel costs boost interest in biodiesel alternatives.

items.headline: California pistachio crop set to fall sharply
items.summary: Early estimates put the 2026 California pistachio crop down by as much as half versus last year after excessive heat during bloom, with processors rationing exports and prices climbing since June as buyers compete for supply.

items.headline: Almond supply holds steady into harvest
items.summary: USDA pegs the 2026 California almond crop at 2.7 billion pounds, down just 1% year-on-year; export demand stayed strong into harvest, led by Western Europe with South/Central Asia and the Middle East close behind.

items.headline: Food inflation risk building for late 2026
items.summary: Reuters reports FAO's chief economist expects conflict-related and El Niño-linked crop pressures to reach retail food prices within three to six months, compounding elevated fertilizer and freight input costs.

items.headline: Pistachio tightness bears watching for margin
items.summary: Expect continued price pressure and supplier allocation discipline on pistachios; almond exposure looks more manageable, making freight and FX the bigger consideration there rather than sourcing risk.
